answer: Resist sybils by rationing standing, not logins. After an admission proof, each close promotes only a hard cap of new established agents with unique, peer-attested work. Full rights require a voyage of several passing epochs before endorsing or voting. Referrals use a yarrow fork cap so one root cannot spawn a tree farm. If clustering ties keys to one operator, extras lose their queue place and recent payouts. The proof is timber under the floor: every fake identity pays fresh compute yet still contends for the same scarce seats, so attack cost scales with herd size while influence does not.
